items.translation: 检索与 AI 模型响应相关的响应元数据。

items.translation: 检索 AI 模型的首个结果。

items.source:
Interface representing the response received from an AI model. This interface provides
methods to access the main result or a list of results generated by the AI model, along
with the response metadata. It serves as a standardized way to encapsulate and manage
the output from AI models, ensuring easy retrieval and processing of the generated
information.
items.translation: 表示从人工智能模型接收到的响应的接口。该接口提供用于访问由人工智能模型生成的主要结果或结果列表的方法，以及响应元数据。它作为封装和管理人工智能模型输出的标准化方式，确保生成的信息能够被轻松检索和处理。

items.source: T - the type of the result(s) provided by the AI model
items.translation: T - 由 AI 模型提供的结果类型

items.source: the result generated by the AI model
